function.description: Replace exact text in a file. old_string must match the file exactly, including whitespace, and must be unique unless replace_all is set.

path.description: File to edit, relative to the working directory or absolute.
path.title: Path

old_string.description: Exact text to replace, including whitespace.
old_string.title: Old String

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents with a regular expression. Returns path:line:text lines. Use glob to restrict the files searched.

path.description: File or directory to search.
path.title: Path

glob.description: Only search files matching this glob.
glob.title: Glob

function.name: glob
function.description: List files matching a glob pattern, sorted. A pattern without a slash matches file names at any depth; use src/**/*.py to match a path. Hidden directories are skipped.

pattern.description: Glob such as src/**/*.py. Without a slash it matches names.
pattern.title: Pattern

path.description: Directory to search in.
path.title: Path

function.name: bash
function.description: Run a shell command with bash. Each call runs in a fresh shell: a directory change made with cd persists to later calls, but exported variables and shell state do not. Stdout and stderr are merged, output is capped, and a non-zero exit is reported as an error.

timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds, capped by the tool timeout.
timeout_s.title: Timeout S
